WITH transactions_with_customers AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.transaction_amount,
    c.state_county_province
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  INNER JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    SUM(transaction_amount) as state_total
  FROM transactions_with_customers
  GROUP BY state_county_province
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(state_total) as total_sum
  FROM state_totals
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.state_county_province,
    st.state_total,
    st.state_total / gt.total_sum as share
  FROM state_totals st
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM state_shares
),
above_average_states AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.state_total,
    ss.share,
    ashr.avg_share
  FROM state_shares ss
  CROSS JOIN average_share ashr
  WHERE ss.share > ashr.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(state_total) as combined_transaction_total,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess_share
FROM above_average_states

assumptions.assumption: Null transaction_amount values are excluded from sums (standard SQL behavior for aggregates)
A customer belongs to exactly one state_county_province; all transactions from all of a customer's accounts are attributed to their single state
States with NULL state_county_province are included as a separate group
